answers.core: Array manipulation is a core part of said built-in type. Having it presented as an option in the core API is certain to save someone from a bear trap if they are trying to do any multi-removal. The naïve implementation of iterating through the array (possibly from the start at that) and removing items one at a time is O(n*m). The above algorithm keeps it O(n) plus sorting the indices, which could be removed and assumed/enforced.
